Interactive Robotics Terminal CLI

📖 Interactive CLI Guide & Command Cheatsheet (Click to expand / collapse)
QUICK CHEATSHEET
AI Robotics Assistant (Multi-Backend)
  • ai <question>: Inquire about Proxemics, algorithms, or physics
  • ai key <API_KEY>: Connect Google Gemini API (Unscripted LLM)
  • ai provider <gemini|ollama|nano|local>: Switch AI Core
  • ai model <name>: Configure model (e.g., gemini-2.5-flash, llama3)
  • ai analyze: Evaluate real-time scene safety & get recommendations
  • ai status: Inspect active AI Core, API key, & memory stats
  • ai clear: Reset multi-turn conversation memory buffer
Simulation Physics & Control (sim)
  • sim status: View live telemetry gauges & robot metrics
  • sim pause | sim resume | sim reset: Control execution loop
  • sim algo <sfm|sarl|mpc|orca|cadrl|nonsocial>: Switch algorithm
  • sim scenario <scand_plaza|jrdb_quad|eth_univ|...>: Load dataset
  • sim speed <m/s> & sim courtesy <0.1-2.0>: Tune speed & yielding
  • sim spawn <x> <y> & sim pillar <x> <y>: Add dynamic entities
  • sim lidar <on|off> & sim heatmap <on|off>: Toggle sensor overlays
ROS2 Ecosystem & 3D Export
  • ros2 topic list: List active topics (/scan, /odom, /social_costmap, /tracked_humans)
  • ros2 topic echo <topic>: Stream live sensor_msgs / nav_msgs payload frame
  • export world: Generate 3D Gazebo Classic 11 (.world) model
  • export sdf: Generate 3D Ignition Gazebo (.sdf) model
Analytics, Theory & Utilities
  • analytics stats: Inspect compliance metrics & violations summary
  • analytics csv | analytics json: Export research trial logs
  • theory <proxemics|algo|benchmarks|datasets>: Open math formulations
  • theme <dracula|obsidian|tokyo|apollo|emerald|light|...>: Switch studio theme
  • clear: Clear terminal screen | ↑/↓: Navigate command history
